name: Serfauserhof
beschreibung:
The Hotel Garni Serfauserhof is a four-star property in the center of Serfaus (6534) in the Landeck district. It is run by the Georg and Karin Schalber family and describes itself as the smallest four-star hotel in the village. The "Zentrum" subway stop is about 100 meters away.

The offering consists exclusively of rooms with breakfast, from double and comfort rooms to junior and family suites and family rooms; all rooms have a balcony. Amenities include a small bathing and sauna world with indoor pool, steam bath, relaxation room, and infrared cabin, free Wi-Fi, and free parking at the house. In summer, the region's Super Summer Card for Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis is included in the price. Daily rates start seasonally at around 77 euros in summer and 125 euros in winter per person with breakfast. The property is open from mid-June to mid-October and from early December to early April.
